examples.text: J’ai pogné un rhume.

examples.text: Voyons, qu’est-ce qui te pogne tout d’un coup?
examples.translation: Hey, what's gotten into you all of a sudden?
examples.english: Hey, what's gotten into you all of a sudden?

glosses: to surprise, to run into, to find out (someone in the act of wrongdoing, someone in hiding)

examples.text: Il s'est fait pogner par son patron.
examples.translation: He was found out by his boss.
examples.english: He was found out by his boss.

examples.text: Je roulais à une vitesse normale, mais j’ai pogné une bosse et je ne m’y attendais pas.
examples.translation: I was driving at a regular speed, but I hit a bump and I wasn't expecting it.
examples.english: I was driving at a regular speed, but I hit a bump and I wasn't expecting it.

examples.text: Il a pogné trois ans de prison.
examples.translation: He got three years of jail time.
examples.english: He got three years of jail time.

examples.text: La pognes-tu?
examples.translation: Do you get it?
examples.english: Do you get it?

examples.translation: I don't understand.
examples.english: I don't understand.

glosses: to catch on or become popular, to succeed

examples.text: Ma musique pogne pas.
examples.translation: My music isn't catching on.
examples.english: My music isn't catching on.

examples.text: Notre site Internet pogne de plus en plus.
examples.translation: Our Web site is getting more and more popular.
examples.english: Our Web site is getting more and more popular.

glosses: to seduce, to have success in interpersonal relationships

examples.text: J’ai beau aller dans les bars, je pogne pas pantoute.
examples.translation: Try as I might at bars, I can't get any.
examples.english: Try as I might at bars, I can't get any.

examples.text: Ce gars-là pogne vraiment, toutes les filles sont à ses pieds.

examples.english: That guy's a real lady-killer! All the girls are at his feet.

glosses: to take or acquire something (for oneself)

examples.text: C’est gratuit! Pogne-toi-z-en une couple!
examples.translation: It's free! Take a few!
examples.english: It's free! Take a few!

examples.text: C’est tellement bon, cet album-là, je vais m’en pogner un c’est sûr!
examples.translation: This album's really good! I'm definitely going to get it for myself.
examples.english: This album's really good! I'm definitely going to get it for myself.

glosses: to become stuck or jammed (of one object in another, used reflexively)

examples.text: Il s’est pogné le doigt dans la machine.
examples.translation: He got his finger stuck in the machine.
examples.english: He got his finger stuck in the machine.

examples.text: J’ai peur de me pogner les cheveux dans le filtreur de la piscine.
examples.translation: I'm afraid of getting my hair stuck in the pool filtration system.
examples.english: I'm afraid of getting my hair stuck in the pool filtration system.

glosses: to argue, to quarrel, to butt heads

examples.text: C’est la troisième fois qu’il se pogne avec le prof cette semaine.
examples.translation: That's the third time this week that he's beefed with the professor.
examples.english: That's the third time this week that he's beefed with the professor.

examples.text: Quand on se pogne avec quelqu’un à tout bout de champ, je pense que c’est mieux de prendre ses distances.
examples.translation: When you're butting heads with someone and there's no end in sight, I think it's better to keep your distance.
examples.english: When you're butting heads with someone and there's no end in sight, I think it's better to keep your distance.
